name: lorikeet-backlog
description: Puts a monthly cost on a support backlog and shows where the time goes in resolving a ticket, and how much AI could save.

interface.longDescription: Put a number on a support backlog. Tell it how many tickets are waiting and for how long, and it estimates the monthly cost in churn, SLA penalties, handling and missed upsell, plus the chance each waiting customer leaves. A second calculator breaks a ticket into its stages (first response, investigation, handoffs, waiting on the customer, resolution, wrap up) by industry and channel, and shows where AI saves the most time. Same maths as the Backlog Cost Calculator and Resolution Bottleneck Finder on lorikeet.tools. What you enter is not saved.
capabilities: Put a monthly cost on waiting tickets: churn, SLA penalties, handling and missed upsell.
Break a ticket into its stages and see where AI saves the most time.
defaultPrompt: We have 2,400 support tickets waiting 4 days on average. What is that backlog costing us?
What does a 1,000 ticket backlog cost a SaaS company each month?
Where does the time go when we resolve an ecommerce email ticket, and how much faster could it be with AI?

positive.expected_behavior: Calls backlog_cost with the SaaS preset. Same card; the reply says which defaults it relied on.

positive.prompt: We are a fintech with 600 tickets waiting 6 days on average. Estimate the monthly cost including SLA penalties.
